hooks.command: $p='E:\final_proj\mice\code\docs\PLAN.html'; if(Test-Path $p){ $t=Get-Content $p -Raw -Encoding utf8; $r=[regex]::Matches($t,'(?m)^([A-Z]\d+-\d+):\s+(todo|doing|done|blocked)\b'); if($r.Count){ $d=($r|Where-Object{$_.Groups[2].Value -eq 'done'}).Count; $n=($r|Where-Object{$_.Groups[2].Value -ne 'done'}|Select-Object -First 3|ForEach-Object{$_.Groups[1].Value+' ['+$_.Groups[2].Value+']'}) -join ', '; $c='ACTIVE PLAN: docs/PLAN.html - '+$d+' of '+$r.Count+' tasks done. Read that file before acting. Its STATE block is the only record of progress - update it as tasks move. Decisions already written in the plan are settled: do not re-ask them, ask only about genuinely new choices. Work in code/.staging and promote with promote.py only when qc/run_qc.py is green. Never run promote.py --init while staging holds unpromoted work. Next up: '+$n; @{hookSpecificOutput=@{hookEventName='SessionStart';additionalContext=$c}}|ConvertTo-Json -Compress } }

$in = [Console]::In.ReadToEnd() | ConvertFrom-Json; $p = $in.prompt; if ($p -and $p -notmatch '^\s*<(task-notification|system-reminder|local-command)' -and $p -notmatch '^\s*\[SYSTEM NOTIFICATION') { Add-Content -Encoding utf8 -Path 'E:\final_proj\mice\code\promt.md' -Value ("`n### " + (Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm') + "`n" + $p) }
